meta.title: NEFU Digital Dean's Office — concept
meta.description: A concept of a student account for NEFU: schedule, grades, certificates and notifications in one place.

concept.note: Contest concept. Not an official NEFU service. All data is fictional.

common.soonText: This section will appear in one of the next stages.

today.leadStudent: What matters right now: classes, changes, grades and requests.
today.leadStaff: A short overview for today. Student requests will live in the staff cabinet later.
today.noClass: No classes today or tomorrow — you can breathe out.
today.noChanges: No reschedules for today or tomorrow.

pages.schedule: Schedule for today, tomorrow and the week, with clearly marked changes.
pages.grades: Points per course and hints: to admission, to an automatic grade, to an excellent mark.
pages.requests: Order certificates and submit applications online, then track their status.
pages.notifications: Dean's office news, ready certificates and schedule changes.
pages.profile: Your details, interface language and sign out.
